summary: HSBC filed a 6-K reporting daily repurchases under its buy-back announced 28 October 2026. On 6 November it bought 3,500,000 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of US$12.9998 (range US$12.9040–13.0880) and 9,600 shares in Hong Kong at HK$138.4042 (range HK$137.8000–139.5000), all for cancellation via Goldman Sachs International. Cumulative buy-back totals 7,559,061 shares for roughly US$130.9m; issued capital stands at 17,130,540,846 shares with no treasury holdings. Watch execution pace and Hong Kong cancellation timing.
